title: The Five-Step Process, Step 5: Self-Discipline, Iteration, and Pushing to Results
summary: President Hughes concludes his five-step process for achieving big goals by detailing Step 5: taking action and pushing designs through to productive results. He emphasizes building self-discipline, understanding the 'why' behind repetitive daily tasks, using prioritized lists, and forming synergistic, win-win relationships with others to complement personal weaknesses.
